card.name: Inside foreign place and drug names
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle of a rare proper name, usually a Slavic or Eastern European place or term, after its first letters. Also fires in the drug name ustekinumab after 'ust'.

modes.label: Slavic place and word names
modes.description: A middle piece of a Slavic or Russian place name or word, such as Seidnaya, Plesetsk, Sputnik or Sieroca.
modes.example: Below is a location map and aerial view of Se<<id>>naya.

modes.label: Inside ustekinumab
modes.description: The 'ek' piece inside the drug name ustekinumab.

card.writes: It mostly suppresses odd name fragments and promotes unrelated pieces such as band and strap, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up partway through unusual foreign names, such as Slavic towns, and inside the drug name ustekinumab.
